body:
Founder: 'can we add a 3d scene like the shankpit level editor for the animations models viewer?' Built AnimationViewer.tsx -- first real JS/TS binary parser for GOLDENBAND's .gskel/.gmesh/.gband formats, verified byte-exact against real stored data via a standalone Node script (joint count 65, vertex/index counts, computed vs actual file size matching exactly, channel names correct). Builds a real THREE.Bone/Skeleton/SkinnedMesh using the asset's own stored inverse-bind matrices, and a real THREE.AnimationClip from .gband channels with rest-pose fallback for uncovered ticks/components -- THREE's own AnimationMixer does the actual skinning math, not a second hand-rolled implementation. Reuses the same Three.js foundation ShankpitLevelEditor.tsx already has (OrbitControls, WebGLRenderer, rAF loop). Handles mesh-only (unskinned) and rig-only (wireframe skeleton) fallback cases. Play/pause + scrub slider, auto-framed camera. tsc/build clean, redeployed. Commit 84304af.

⚓ ☃
title: NOCK Animations tab -- real in-browser 3D preview (THREE.SkinnedMesh + AnimationMixer)
